table.name: TLGNC_ASSIGNMENT_PART
table.description: An assignment consists of several parts to be executed in a defined order. Examples of parts of such a sequence: loading, driving-to, unloading, ... The end (point and date/time) of a part is defined by the start point and date/time of the next part in the sequence.

column.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_ASSIGNMENT. The assignment this part belongs to.

column.name: ASSIGNMENT_PART_SEQ_NO
column.description: The parts of an assignment are arranged in a sequence, defined by these numbers.

column.name: ASSIGNMENT_PART_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_ASSIGNMENT_PART_TYPE_BS. The type (some kind of action) of this part: 0=pre-loading, 1=loading, 2=driving-to, ... An artificial type 5=finished is introduced for technical reasons in each assignment. Note that the execution order is defined by ASSIGNMENT_PART_SEQ_NO, not by this type!

column.name: ORDER_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_ORDER. The order which is unloaded. Only set for assignment_parts of type unloading. It it not possible to set this reference also for type 'loading' because several order_items with the same material are collected into one load (relevant for case bag at the moment).

column.name: EXT_ORDER_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_EXT_ORDER. The external order which is unloaded.

column.name: LOAD_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_LOAD. The load which is loaded. Only set for assignment_parts of type loading, null for all other types of assignment_part. For service items no loading part is created.

column.name: ASSIGN_PART_STATUS_CD
column.description: FK TLGNR_ASSIGN_PART_STATUS_BS. The status of this assignment part: 0=new, 2=confirmed by driver. These are the only possible statuses.

column.name: PRE_PLANNED_START
column.description: Date and time when this part should start its execution. Set by the crh scheduler when scheduling the orders.

column.name: PLANNED_START
column.description: Date and time when this part should start its execution. Set by the scheduler when scheduling orders.

column.name: REAL_START
column.description: Date and time when this part actually started. The start date/time of a part is the end date/time of the previous part in the sequence.

column.name: COORD_LAT
column.description: Latitude coordinates of the start of this part (=end of previous part). Start must be defined by either coordinates, shippingpoint or shipto. If shipto is 'location not fixed (one-time shipto)', both shipto+coord(+site) fields are set!

column.name: COORD_LON
column.description: Longitute coordinates of the start of this part (=end of previous part). Start must be defined by either coordinates, shippingpoint or shipto. If shipto is 'location not fixed (one-time shipto)', both shipto+coord(+site) fields are set!

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SHIPPINGPOINT. Shipping point of the start of this part (=end of previous part). Start must be defined by either coordinates, shippingpoint or shipto.

column.name: SHIPTO_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SHIPTO. Shipto of the start of this part (=end of previous part). Start must be defined by either coordinates, shippingpoint or shipto. If shipto is 'location not fixed (one-time shipto)', both shipto+coord(+site) fields are set!

column.name: SITE_NAME
column.description: Name of the equivalent to a Shippingpoint or Shipto, mainly for external orders. The object it describes depends on assignment_part_type_cd. (Name Verladestelle, Name Empfaenger, ...)

column.name: SITE_LOAD_UNLOAD
column.description: Name of the equivalent to a Loadingpoint or Silo, mainly for external orders. The object it describes depends on assignment_part_type_cd. (Ladestelle/-strasse, Entladestelle/Silo, ...)

column.name: SITE_CONTACT_PERSON_TXT
column.description: Contact person and contact information for the position. Value is free text. The contact person for assignment_part of type 'unloading' is initially set to the value of tlgnc_order.contact_person_txt

column.name: SITE_STREET_HOUSE_NO
column.description: Address information for the site: Street and Housenumber

column.name: SITE_COUNTRY
column.description: Address information for the site: Country

column.name: SITE_POSTAL_CODE
column.description: Address information for the site: Postal Code

column.name: SITE_CITY
column.description: Address information for the site: City

column.name: HOMEBASE_FLAG
column.description: 0=truck not at homebase, 1=truck at homebase. Relevant only for Trucks. For Wagons: There is no concept of 'homebase' similar to trucks, but rather a 'return location' (which is handled differently). Trailers do not have a homebase, and containers are not moveable on their own (only in combination with a truck/wagon) and therefore do not generate independent bizevents on their own.

column.name: LNF_SHIPTO_FLAG
column.description: 1=site/coord fields are defining the location for the shipto_id, which is a 'location not fixed' type. Such an assignment part has site/coord fields set AND shipto_id. 0=normal assignment part, only 1 out of coord/shippingpoint/shipto must be set and is respected.

column.name: TRANSPORT_DISTANCE_M
column.description: Transport distance from shipping point to ship-to in m. For truck orders, Google Maps is used. For rail orders distance information comes from tlgnc_rail_distance. In the case of carrier stock, when in reality the order is not loaded at the shippingpoint stored on order, but from the carrier stock shippingpoint (stored on the assignment), this field is overwritten with the real distance between the carrier stock shippingpoint and the final delivery place (fix shipto place, or in case of LNF shipto, LNF coordinates). Used for logistics aspects.
